Not for fabrication. Concept schematic for visualization and layout only.
Port half removed; starboard internal layout shown
Air revitalization, thermal control, water recovery
GN&C, FDIR, nav sensors, PDU, batteries
1. All dimensions nominal. Tolerances not shown.
2. RCS thrusters located in fore/aft quads for 6-DOF control.
3. Thermal radiators service ECLSS and avionics loops.
4. Solar arrays provide primary power; batteries support eclipse ops.
5. Materials and fasteners omitted for clarity.
